752:t_2:121.en:
$$ルイス$$
「All we can do is pray for you from here, but...!」

752:t_2:122.en:
$$恭子$$
「But we'll do our very best!」

752:t_2:124.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「So win! Win this for us!」

752:t_2:125.en:
$$風間$$
「Don't lose, $c! Don't lose, Volunteer Club!!」

752:t_3:4.en:
$n
(I can't see anything... I can't hear anything...)

752:t_3:5.en:
$n
(Has the world... come to an end...?)

752:t_3:11.en:
$$桂$$
「...The multiverse is being restored to the world as it was...」

752:t_3:12.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So it's all going back to the world before the $$時空震動弾$$ went off... before the $$大時空震動$$...」

752:t_3:13.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「And as spacetime is restored, everyone will return to their own worlds...」

752:t_3:14.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then we'll be going back too...!」

752:t_3:15.en:
$$勝平$$
「Does that mean we'll all be split up!?」

752:t_3:17.en:
$$正太郎$$
「It's unavoidable if we're to protect the universe, isn't it...」

752:t_3:18.en:
$$赤木$$
「Let's hold our heads high. Our memories aren't going to disappear, you know.」

752:t_3:19.en:
$$アマタ$$
「You're right! I'll never forget the days I fought in $c!」

752:t_3:20.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Even if I wanted to forget, I couldn't!」

752:t_3:23.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's how we've lived, giving it everything we had.」

752:t_3:24.en:
$$刹那$$
「Those days will remain as memories.」

752:t_3:28.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The day will come when humanity can control even spacetime. We've only just stepped into the gateway of evolution, after all.」

752:t_3:29.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Is something like that... really possible...?」

752:t_3:30.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'm sure we'll do it someday. That's the potential we have.」

752:t_3:31.en:
$$ノノ$$
「And the ones who'll make it happen are...!」

752:t_3:33.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Let's do this! Starting today, it all begins again!」

752:t_3:34.en:
$$ロラン$$
「In each of the worlds being born anew, each of us will keep on living and doing our best...」

752:t_3:36.en:
$$アルト$$
「So until that day, it's just a short goodbye, huh.」

752:t_3:38.en:
$$バサラ$$
「If you burn your heart out, spacetime doesn't matter!」

752:t_3:39.en:
$$レド$$
「That's right. No matter how far apart we are, our feelings are one.」

752:t_3:40.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「As of today, $c is disbanded. But its existence is eternal.」

752:t_3:41.en:
$$葵$$
「Feelings are eternal... Maybe that's where our $$シンカ$$ is headed.」

752:t_3:42.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Maybe. But it doesn't feel bad.」

752:t_3:43.en:
$$甲児$$
「We've been fighting for this very moment, haven't we...」

752:t_3:44.en:
$$シモン$$
「And then, the fighting starts again.」

752:t_3:45.en:
$$桂$$
「To keep on living...! That's our fight in the new world!」

752:t_3:50.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You guys lent us your strength too, huh.」

752:t_3:51.en:
$$ユーサー$$
「It seems a part of our souls was left behind in each of the $$スフィア$$s.」

752:t_3:52.en:
$$アイム#pilot$$
「That part of us seems to have been awakened by the power of life delivered from Earth.」

752:t_3:54.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「There's no need to be sad, $$セツコ$$.」

752:t_3:55.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「The Supreme God will vanish, and the $$スフィア$$s will disappear too...」

752:t_3:56.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「With this, our souls, which were caught between the force that seeks to vanish and the force that seeks to exist, will be freed as well.」

752:t_3:57.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I have nothing left to regret. We lived with everything we had, and the universe was saved.」

752:t_3:61.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「When that time comes, let's rejoice in our reunion.」

752:t_3:62.en:
$$ランド$$
「Somehow, hearing that from you guys makes me uneasy...」

752:t_3:63.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「But I think that's still a long way off.」

752:t_3:65.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「As long as that light remains, live with everything you have.」

752:t_3:66.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You don't even need to say it.」

752:t_3:67.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Thank you. Now I can ride a new wind...」

752:t_3:68.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Yes... the wind is calling... That voice... that I heard once...」

752:t_3:71.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Seems he's got business of his own to take care of.」

752:t_3:72.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then tell him this as well. Live strong.」

752:t_3:74.en:
$$ランド$$
「See ya! Take care of yourselves, everyone!」

752:t_3:82.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I will carry the last remaining force that seeks to vanish beyond the causal horizon.」

752:t_3:84.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's quite all right. I've enjoyed myself more than enough already.」

752:t_3:85.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Besides, now that the multiverse is coming to an end, both my interest and my role have run out.」

752:t_3:60: Aim's 'waiting for you' has no stated subject; rendered 'We'll be waiting' (Aim speaking for the departed group, as Barbiel/Uther/Elunaluna answer in kind).
uncertain: 因果地平 rendered 'causal horizon' (no settled rendering in the repo; AG 752:t_3:82).
752:t_3:12/11: 元の世界 rendered 'the world as it was' (singular) to match Amuro's 'the world before the Great Spacequake'.
752:t_3:52: それ = 'that part of us' (the soul fragments Uther mentioned).
752:t_3:72: Vildark's 彼 = Hibiki; 'him' is settled by Crowe's $n answer.
752:t_2:121: けど！ left as trailing 'but...!' leading into Kyoko's 'But we'll do our very best!'.
752:t_3:14: Watta's じゃあ、俺達も…！ expanded to 'Then we'll be going back too...!' (scene-settled by Roger's line).
752:t_3:12 uses tokens $$時空震動弾$$ (proposed keyword) and $$大時空震動$$; 752:t_3:41 uses $$シンカ$$.
'Volunteer Club' for ボランティア部, matching earlier finished slices.
